Th is revision coming on for hearing this day, th e cour  following:

ORDER This petition has been filed under Section 397 of Cr.P.C. against the order of learned Sessions Judge wherein the learned Special Judge , District Dhar has allowed the appeal filed by the petitioners and reduced the fine amount of the petitioners from Rs.75,000/- each to Rs.5000/- each under Section 26(20(ii) and 27 r/w Section 52 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
Earlier also on 08.03.2024, no one has appeared on behalf of the petitioner and today also, none for the petitioner.

Deepak vs Sanjeev Kumar on 18 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/97750928/

It seems that the petitioners have lost their interest in prosecuting the present petition.
Hence, the petition is dismissed for want of prosecution.
In view of the findings of learned appellate Court, the impugned judgement of learned first appellant Court stands affirmed.
A copy of this order be sent to the learned Courts below concerned.
